description: Admin UI surface for managing mcp_policy_rules in the Search-Driven UI (port 8790). Must read existing policy rules via registry_api on :8781, present as HTML table with columns: rule_id, rule_type, pattern, action, created_at. Must include form for admin to create new policy rule. Per spec Section 3 signal invariant: policy rules must not introduce new signal shapes or verdict tiers. Write actions via write_service.
